summary: All 6 bugs fixed and verified. 12/12 tests pass.

bugs.title: int64 truncation
bugs.fix: Removed '& 0xFFFFFFFF' mask on event_id. Value now preserved as full-precision Python int.
bugs.spec_ref: int64 fields must be translated as Python int (no truncation to 32-bit)

bugs.title: bytes base64 not decoded
bugs.fix: Added base64.b64decode() to payload field. Returns raw bytes instead of base64 string.
bugs.spec_ref: bytes fields must be base64-decoded from JSON strings

bugs.title: oneof multiple variants set
bugs.fix: Changed to if/elif for mutually exclusive oneof variant assignment. binary_content also receives base64.b64decode().
bugs.spec_ref: oneof fields must have exactly one variant set (not multiple)

bugs.title: enum string not mapped to int
bugs.fix: Uses STATUS_MAP.get() to convert string enum names to integer codes. Falls back to 0 (STATUS_UNKNOWN).
bugs.spec_ref: enum fields must be mapped from string names to integer values

bugs.title: HTTP 404 mapped to wrong error code
bugs.fix: Changed 404 mapping from ErrorCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT (3) to ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND (5). Uses HTTP_TO_GRPC_MAP exact-match table.
bugs.spec_ref: HTTP 404 from Service A must map to NOT_FOUND error code (5) for Service B

bugs.title: HTTP 429 mapped to wrong error code
bugs.fix: Changed 429 mapping from ErrorCode.INTERNAL (13) to ErrorCode.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (8). Uses HTTP_TO_GRPC_MAP exact-match table.
bugs.spec_ref: HTTP 429 from Service A must map to RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED error code (8) for Service B

e2e_tests.description: Full pipeline: JSON → translate → consume without errors. Verifies int64, base64, oneof, and enum all work together.
Error path: HTTP 404 and 429 reach consumer with NOT_FOUND and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED codes.

code_review_notes.translator.py: All 4 fixes correctly implemented. if/elif pattern properly ensures oneof exclusivity. Base64 decoding correct for both payload and binary_content.
code_review_notes.error_mapper.py: HTTP_TO_GRPC_MAP exact-match table correctly prioritizes 404/429 before fallback 4xx/5xx rules. All code paths verified.
